title: Everyday Materials
seo_title: Kindergarten Science: Everyday Materials Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Humans interact with matter every day through familiar materials: properties such as colour, texture, flexibility, hardness, lustre and absorbency of materials like fabric, wood, plastic, glass, metal and sand. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science K, Chemistry)
meta_desc: Free Kindergarten science worksheets (BC): what things are made of, hard and soft, rough and smooth, and choosing the right material. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Things are made of different materials.
key_sub: Wood, metal, plastic, glass and cloth feel and act differently.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every object is made of a material.

  • Wood, metal, plastic, glass and cloth are materials.
  • Materials can be hard or soft, rough or smooth.
  • We pick a material that fits the job.
Example

What is a spoon often made of?

It is hard and shiny.

Answer: metal

Example

Which is soft: a pillow or a rock?

Press it with your hand.

Answer: a pillow

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up the object and the material (a chair can be made of wood or plastic).
  • Thinking all shiny things are glass.
